question: Which of the following is NOT a sign of sexual maturity in girls?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) Cracking of voice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Cracking of voice** is typically associated with puberty in boys, not girls.
 
• During puberty, boys experience a deepening of the voice due to the growth of the larynx and lengthening of the vocal cords.
 
• Girls do not usually experience a significant change in voice pitch during puberty.
 
• The voice changes in girls during puberty are generally more subtle and less pronounced compared to boys.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oily Skin:** An increase in the production of sebum due to hormonal changes often leads to oily skin during puberty in both boys and girls.
 
• **Increase in Breast Size:** One of the primary signs of sexual maturity in girls is the development and growth of breasts.
 
• **Menstruation:** The onset of menstruation is a key indicator of sexual maturity in girls, marking the beginning of reproductive capability.
 
• **Puberty in Girls:** Typically occurs between the ages of 8 and 13 and includes physical changes such as the development of secondary sexual characteristics and the onset of menstruation.
 
• **Hormonal Changes:** Puberty is driven by hormonal changes, primarily the increase in estrogen in girls, which leads to the development of secondary sexual characteristics.
